annotation.title_en: Wife's Infidelity and the Covered Keyhole
annotation.summary_en: A man asks his friend to spy on his wife, but the investigation ends abruptly when a piece of clothing covers the keyhole at the critical moment.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a narrow apartment hallway featuring wood-paneled doors. A man (Sur) meets his friend to get a report on his wife's fidelity, having previously given the friend his house keys to facilitate the surveillance. The friend describes how he caught the wife entering the house with a young man around twenty years old. He explains that he followed them inside and watched through a hole in the bedroom door. The storytelling is intercut with intense, stylized black-and-white shots of the men physically grappling and confronting each other closely. The friend details how the wife turned on music and began a striptease, removing her denim jacket and then her sweater. As the tension peaks and the husband eagerly asks what happened after she removed her bra, the friend reveals the anticlimax: the wife threw her bra right onto the door, perfectly covering the peephole and blocking his view. The sketch ends with the husband's frustration at the unresolved and uncertain situation.
